name: corsclash
description: Flags an Express cors() config (or the raw Access-Control-Allow-* header equivalent) that combines origin: '*' — or an omitted origin, which defaults to '*' — with credentials: true, plus the more dangerous dynamic-origin-reflection callback that achieves the same insecure effect silently.
author: Jay

scripts.build: tsup && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist && cp dist/index.d.ts dist/index.d.cts
